goals.title: EFF · D1 — Joint Engagement & Coordination
goals.description: During dyadic sensorimotor and social routines, the child will demonstrate emerging joint engagement by orienting to and matching the adult's pace, timing, or affect in coordinated exchanges (e.g., mutual gaze, turn-based vocal or motor play), moving from Onlooking/Object-Focused toward Supported Joint Engagement across a minimum of 3--5 consecutive exchanges, with adult scaffolding as needed.

goals.title: EFF · D2 — Emotional Awareness & Empathic Connection
goals.description: During caregiving and play routines, the child will orient to and register the adult's facial expression, tone, or affect shift (e.g., pausing, gaze shift, seeking proximity) in response to at least three distinct affective changes introduced by the adult across a session, evidencing early Recognising Emotional Cues.

goals.title: EFF · D3 — Shared Attention & Experience Sharing
goals.description: During play and caregiving routines, the child will follow the adult's proximal and distal point or gaze to locate a shared object or event across at least 8--10 trials, and will begin to initiate simple joint-attention bids (showing, pointing) to direct the adult's attention, evidencing the shift from Experience Learning toward early Experience Seeking.

goals.title: EFF · D4 — Collaborative Problem Solving & Co-Participation
goals.description: During adult-guided joint tasks (e.g., simple cause-and-effect play, clean-up routines), the child will participate in a complementary role with the adult (e.g., holds an item while the adult places it) across at least three trials, and will demonstrate emerging awareness of self and partner as engaged in a shared activity, evidenced by shared affect or gaze alternation between partner and task.

goals.title: PMF · D1 — Observational Learning & Internalized Guidance
goals.description: During modelled play or motor sequences, the child will sustain visual attention to the adult's demonstration for five or more seconds prior to acting, and will imitate at least 10 single-step actions on objects across sessions, evidencing the shift from passive observation toward Focused Observation and early Selective Imitation.

goals.title: PMF · D2 — Meaning-Making & Internal Dialogue
goals.description: During sorting and matching play, the child will match or sort at least 10 identical objects or pictures across a session, and will show an orienting or attentional shift (pause, look longer) in response to a novel versus familiar stimulus, evidencing the pre-verbal categorisation that underlies later Recognising Equivalence and Difference.

goals.title: PMF · D3 — Growth-Seeking Motivation
goals.description: During play with adult-introduced variation, the child will tolerate and, with support, adapt to at least two novel variations of a familiar activity without significant distress, and will show visible enjoyment or curiosity (smile, laugh, sustained engagement) in response to the novelty, across a session.

goals.title: PMF · D4 — Self-Regulation — Attention, Behaviour, Goals & Uncertainty
goals.description: During transitions and mildly dysregulating moments, the child will demonstrate co-regulated recovery (returning to baseline within one to two minutes) with adult support (proximity, voice, rhythm) across daily routines, and will begin to reference the adult's face for information in an ambiguous situation at least once per session.

goals.title: EFF · D1 — Joint Engagement & Coordination
goals.description: Within structured and semi-structured play routines, the child will sustain Coordinated Joint Engagement with an adult and, with support, a peer, by synchronising turn-taking actions and adjusting timing or role across 4--6 reciprocal exchanges, and will begin to tolerate role reversal without extended preparation.

goals.title: EFF · D2 — Emotional Awareness & Empathic Connection
goals.description: Within social routines and picture-based activities, the child will demonstrate Recognising and Responding to Emotional Signals by differentially reacting to at least two basic emotional expressions (happy/sad) and by offering or seeking comfort or affiliative behaviour (hug, approach) when the adult displays distress, across daily interactions.

goals.title: EFF · D3 — Shared Attention & Experience Sharing
goals.description: Within play routines, the child will spontaneously initiate joint-attention bids (showing, pointing, vocalising) to share an interesting object or event with a partner across at least five spontaneous opportunities per session, and will check the partner's face for a reaction after sharing, evidencing Experience Seeking (Initiating Shared Reference).

goals.title: EFF · D4 — Collaborative Problem Solving & Co-Participation
goals.description: Within simple two-step joint tasks, the child will perform an assigned complementary role (e.g., holds while the adult pours) and will demonstrate pride or joy at joint completion (clapping, smiling, vocalising) across at least three shared activities per session, evidencing Experiencing Collaborative Unity.

goals.title: PMF · D1 — Observational Learning & Internalized Guidance
goals.description: Within modelled multi-step play sequences, the child will imitate the essential or relevant features of a 2--3 step action sequence (rather than copying every detail) and will spontaneously repeat a learned sequence without prompting in a subsequent session, evidencing Selective Imitation and Spontaneous Practice.

goals.title: PMF · D2 — Meaning-Making & Internal Dialogue
goals.description: Within categorisation play, the child will sort common objects into 'same' and 'different' groups across at least two attributes (shape, size) and will verbalise or gesture a simple reason for the grouping ('these both roll'), across at least three opportunities.

goals.title: PMF · D3 — Growth-Seeking Motivation
goals.description: Within independent play, the child will initiate exploration of unfamiliar toys or materials without prompting and will attempt a learned action independently (without adult modelling) at least twice per session, showing positive affect during self-directed problem-solving, evidencing early Motivation for Increased Agency.

goals.title: PMF · D4 — Self-Regulation — Attention, Behaviour, Goals & Uncertainty
goals.description: Within play and daily routines, the child will follow a one- to two-step instruction to stop or wait without physical prompting, and will demonstrate an early self-inhibition behaviour (pausing before acting on impulse) in at least two observed opportunities, evidencing the earliest form of General Regulation of Action.

goals.title: EFF · D1 — Joint Engagement & Coordination
goals.description: During cooperative games and turn-based play with peers and adults, the child will demonstrate Coordinated to Symbol-Infused Joint Engagement by anticipating a partner's next move, adjusting to introduced variations in the activity, and independently repairing brief coordination breakdowns (e.g., re-initiating after a missed turn), sustained across a full game or activity sequence.

goals.title: EFF · D2 — Emotional Awareness & Empathic Connection
goals.description: In structured social activities, the child will demonstrate Sharing Emotional Experience by identifying happy/sad/mad/scared in photos and in a partner's face, matching own facial affect to the identified emotion, and joining the partner's emotional tone (e.g., shared laughter), across at least four opportunities.

goals.title: EFF · D3 — Shared Attention & Experience Sharing
goals.description: During shared book-reading, games, or conversation, the child will draw a partner's attention to an object or event verbally or gesturally to comment, show, share, or request, and will respond to the partner's own joint-attention bids by looking and commenting, across a minimum of five reciprocal exchanges.

goals.title: EFF · D4 — Collaborative Problem Solving & Co-Participation
goals.description: During cooperative games and constructive play with an adult or peer, the child will coordinate roles and responsibilities (e.g., alternates turns, adjusts pace to a partner) to sustain a joint task to completion, and will suggest or accept an idea to solve a shared problem (e.g., which piece goes where), across at least two collaborative activities.

goals.title: PMF · D1 — Observational Learning & Internalized Guidance
goals.description: During therapist-modelled problem-solving tasks, the child will pause briefly before acting (internal rehearsal) and will verbally or gesturally narrate a planning step ('first... then...') prior to completing a familiar sequence independently, across at least three opportunities.

goals.title: PMF · D2 — Meaning-Making & Internal Dialogue
goals.description: Following a completed activity or a minor disruption, the child will construct a simple causal statement about what happened ('it fell because...') and will recall or reference a prior similar event or session ('we did this before'), across at least three spontaneous instances per week, evidencing early Meaning-Making and Recognising Recurrence.

goals.title: PMF · D3 — Growth-Seeking Motivation
goals.description: During structured and free play, the child will request to 'try alone' or self-initiate a task without adult prompting across at least three opportunities per session, and will verbalise or display pride upon independent completion ('I did it'), while tolerating at least one introduced variation without disengaging.

goals.title: PMF · D4 — Self-Regulation — Attention, Behaviour, Goals & Uncertainty
goals.description: During structured tasks, the child will use a simple self-talk phrase ('wait,' 'my turn') to regulate an impulse or sustain attention on task for three to five minutes, and will detect and self-correct at least one action-outcome mismatch with minimal adult cueing, across at least two sessions per week.

goals.title: EFF · D1 — Joint Engagement & Coordination
goals.description: In group play and cooperative tasks involving two or more peers, the child will demonstrate Collaborative Joint Engagement by taking on and flexibly exchanging complementary roles, adjusting to changes improvised by peers, and independently repairing coordination breakdowns without adult mediation, sustained across an extended (10+ minute) activity.

goals.title: EFF · D2 — Emotional Awareness & Empathic Connection
goals.description: During peer interaction and structured emotion-coaching activities, the child will demonstrate Understanding Cause and Perspective by identifying the situational cause of another's emotion, naming their own feelings appropriately, and applying at least one self-generated coping or repair strategy when upset, across real or simulated scenarios.

goals.title: EFF · D3 — Shared Attention & Experience Sharing
goals.description: In peer conversation and cooperative play, the child will engage in Experience Comparing by initiating dialogue to compare their own and a partner's reactions or preferences to a shared event, and will tolerate and show curiosity about differing perspectives, across at least three conversational exchanges.

goals.title: EFF · D4 — Collaborative Problem Solving & Co-Participation
goals.description: In peer-directed dramatic and constructive play, the child will engage in Co-Regulated Problem Solving by negotiating next steps, accepting or refining a peer's idea, and reflecting on the joint outcome ('it worked' / 'let's try again'), sustaining the cooperative activity across a 10+ minute play episode without adult mediation.

goals.title: PMF · D1 — Observational Learning & Internalized Guidance
goals.description: Across novel but related tasks, the child will apply a previously modelled strategy to a new context with minimal re-demonstration, and will verbally reflect on what was observed and how it informed their own action, across at least two documented instances per month.

goals.title: PMF · D2 — Meaning-Making & Internal Dialogue
goals.description: During reflective conversation after an activity, the child will narrate personal learning ('I figured it out') or a self-generated strategy ('I told myself to wait') in response to open prompts, and will acknowledge that a partner may think or feel differently about the same event, across at least two documented opportunities.

goals.title: PMF · D3 — Growth-Seeking Motivation
goals.description: Across therapy and home tasks, the child will voluntarily select a moderately challenging activity over an easy or repetitive one, will persist through initial difficulty using a self-generated coping strategy (pause, retry, ask for help appropriately), and will express a growth-oriented statement ('I can try again') after an unsuccessful first attempt, across at least two documented opportunities per week.

goals.title: PMF · D4 — Self-Regulation — Attention, Behaviour, Goals & Uncertainty
goals.description: Across home and therapy tasks, the child will independently sustain attention to a task for 10 or more minutes with self-redirection after distraction, will follow a two-step conditional rule (e.g., 'do A until B, then C'), and will use social referencing constructively (checking with an adult under uncertainty) rather than withdrawing, across weekly documented instances.

goals.title: EFF · D1 — Joint Engagement & Coordination
goals.description: Across structured group activities (games, projects, sports) involving multiple peers, the child will demonstrate sustained co-regulated collaboration by independently negotiating roles, monitoring group coordination, and initiating repair when the group's joint focus breaks down, without requiring adult facilitation.

goals.title: EFF · D2 — Emotional Awareness & Empathic Connection
goals.description: Across group and one-to-one social contexts, the child will demonstrate Expressing Empathic Intent by spontaneously offering comfort or assistance to a distressed peer, recognising the boundaries or comfort level of others, and adjusting their own behaviour based on an inferred emotional perspective, without adult prompting, in at least three naturally occurring opportunities per week.

goals.title: EFF · D3 — Shared Attention & Experience Sharing
goals.description: Across academic, social, and conversational contexts, the child will independently monitor and maintain shared reference or topic during multi-turn conversation, redirect a partner's attention when misaligned, and repair the joint focus after a distraction, sustaining topic maintenance and appropriate shifting across a five-minute or longer exchange.

goals.title: EFF · D4 — Collaborative Problem Solving & Co-Participation
goals.description: Across group projects, games, and creative tasks, the child will engage in Creative Co-Participation by contributing an original idea that builds on a peer's contribution, maintaining coordinated rhythm or pace during novelty, and acknowledging the joint product, sustaining shared planning and mutual responsibility for an outcome across a multi-step or multi-session project.

goals.title: PMF · D1 — Observational Learning & Internalized Guidance
goals.description: In academic and social problem-solving contexts, the child will independently transfer an observed strategy to a novel situation without prompting, retain and recall the strategy after a delay (across sessions or days), and articulate the reasoning behind the applied strategy in response to 'what helped you know that?'

goals.title: PMF · D2 — Meaning-Making & Internal Dialogue
goals.description: Across academic and social contexts, the child will independently identify and describe a personal learning or self-regulation strategy used to complete a task, and will construct multi-step causal or temporal narratives ('first--then--next--because') about their own and others' experiences, evidencing mature inner dialogue.

goals.title: PMF · D3 — Growth-Seeking Motivation
goals.description: Across academic, social, and extracurricular contexts, the child will independently select and sustain engagement in a self-chosen challenging task, will tolerate ambiguity or uncertainty in an unfamiliar task by pausing to observe and gather information rather than withdrawing, and will demonstrate a stable growth-mindset statement in response to a setback without requiring external reassurance, across observed opportunities per month.

goals.title: PMF · D4 — Self-Regulation — Attention, Behaviour, Goals & Uncertainty
goals.description: Across academic, social, and community settings, the child will independently self-monitor progress toward a self-generated goal, adjust strategy proactively in response to changing task demands, and tolerate uncertainty in novel situations by alternating between 'studying' (observing) and 'acting' without requiring adult mediation, evidencing full Joint-to-Self Regulation Transition.
